scripts.lint: eslint . && node scripts/check-file-lines.mjs && node scripts/check-lint-disables.mjs && node scripts/check-eslint-fixtures.mjs
scripts.architecture: dependency-cruiser --validate .dependency-cruiser.cjs apps packages workers worker && node scripts/check-manifest-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-architecture-fixtures.mjs
scripts.typecheck: bun run scripts/run-workspaces.mjs typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts && bun run test:app-integrity && vitest run --config vitest.worker.config.ts && bun run test:runtime
scripts.test:runtime-native: vitest run --config vitest.runtime-native.config.ts && bun run test:runtime-production-http && bun run test:runtime-dev-fixture
